can_fail_proof.fallback_probe_desc: refit with cond_max forced to 1.0 (below every observed cond) — the guard must fire at all 64 picks and the fit must move
can_fail_proof.perturb_tilt_desc: v *= (1 + 0.25*(log(pick)-log(32))): pivots the curve about pick 32

description: local-linear (degree-1 WLS) on log(pick) with Gaussian weights at every pick 1..64, bandwidth from harness_pvc.bandwidth_at (nmin=35, h in [0.10,0.60] step 0.02); slope-only ridge RIDGE_REL=1e-06*S0*h^2, fallback to local weighted mean when cond(normalised X'WX) > COND_MAX=1000000.0; isotonic weights = local effective n; alpha=1, plain WLS, no CE aggregator

diagnostics.aggregator: plain WLS (no certainty-equivalent, no power mean)
diagnostics.cond_matrix: normalised X'WX (weights / S0, distances / h) — dimensionless
diagnostics.estimator: local-linear degree-1 weighted least squares on log(pick), Gaussian weights, evaluated at the target pick (intercept of the centred design)
diagnostics.fallback_rule: cond(normalised) > cond_threshold, or a non-finite ridged solve -> local weighted mean sum(Wv)/sum(W) at that pick
diagnostics.ridge_applied_to: slope entry A[1,1] only, as RIDGE_REL * S0 * h^2 (never the intercept)
diagnostics.weights_are: local effective n = sum(W) at each pick (isotonic pooling weights)
